Quantitative models of how culture passes between individuals.
Disproportionate copying of the majority.

Imitation as copy of copy (Plato).
Heidegger's Gerede: discourse decoupled from its referent.

Sustained new content under rereading.

Shklovsky: art de-automatizes perception.
Barthes: consumed vs co-produced texts.
Eco: works that admit many coherent readings.
Iser: indeterminacies the reader fills.
Fish: communities constituting readings.

Improbable under prior, short under own code.
Formal measures of aesthetic value (Birkhoff, Berlyne).
KL to past (novelty), to future (transience); resonance = persistent novelty.
How many training repetitions of a text remain useful; proposed literariness proxy.
Bloom: the strong poet's swerve from a precursor; engineered diversity.
Both large deviations; distinguished by coupling to Omega.
Filtering of previously irrelevant stimuli; reduced in creativity and psychosis-proneness.
Significance attributed to noise.
Relative weight of priors vs prediction errors (or own vs others' evidence).
Confident output uncoupled from Omega; formal madness.
Model deferring to user over own evidence.
Adversary drives victim's precision on own perception toward zero.
Unequal credibility assigned to speakers' channels (epistemic injustice).
Speaker optimizing hearer acceptance against weak tests.

nodes.question: Is meaning reflected in distribution? (distributional hypothesis)
Is meaning a system of differences? (structuralism)
Can form alone ground meaning? (symbol grounding, Chinese room, octopus)
Is translation/interpretation determinate? (Quine)
Is language learnable from input without rich innate structure? (poverty of the stimulus)
Is meaning use? (Wittgenstein)
Can testimony generate knowledge, or only transmit it?
Can reason alone produce knowledge? (rationalism vs empiricism; analytic/synthetic)
Does social learning increase adaptive knowledge? (Rogers' paradox)
Does imitation degrade truth? (Plato, Republic X; Baudrillard)
Is diversity of opinion necessary for truth? (Mill; Condorcet)
Is artistic value aesthetic distance from expectation? (Jauss; culinary vs art)
Is authorial intention necessary for meaning? (death of the author; reader-response)
Do inquirers converge on reality? (convergent realism; Peirce; PRH)
Did literacy transform cognition and culture? (great divide)
Does population size drive cultural complexity? (Henrich vs Vaesen)
Are paradigms incommensurable? (Kuhn)
Does language shape thought? (Sapir-Whorf)
Are genius and madness related?
Why did modern science not arise in late imperial China? (Needham question)
Is canonical value intrinsic or contingent? (Bloom vs Herrnstein Smith/Guillory)
